APPOINTMENT AND SERVICE AGREEMENT

This agreement is between Meridian Infotech Services Private Limited ("the Company") and the Employee named below, who is appointed as a Graduate Engineer Trainee.

1. Place of Posting
1.1 The Employee will initially be posted at Chennai and may be transferred to any location in India at the sole discretion of the Company.

2. Remuneration
2.1 The Employee's annual cost to company is Rs. 4,20,000, including basic pay, special allowance and provident fund.

3. Training and Service Bond
3.1 The Company will train the Employee for six months at considerable cost. In consideration, the Employee agrees to a minimum service period of twenty-four (24) months from the date of joining.
3.2 If the Employee leaves before completing the minimum service period for any reason, the Employee shall pay the Company Rs. 1,50,000, reduced pro rata for each completed month of service, as liquidated damages, which the Company may recover from any amount due to the Employee.

5. Notice
5.1 The Employee shall give ninety (90) days notice of resignation. The Company may terminate the employment by giving ninety (90) days notice.

6. Leave
6.1 Leave shall be as per the Company's leave policy as amended from time to time.
